pdb_description: ABL1 kinase domain in complex with imatinib (STI571), 2.10 Å resolution
disease_area: Chronic Myeloid Leukemia (CML), Philadelphia chromosome-positive ALL
binding_site: ATP-binding cleft, activation loop (DFG-out conformation in 1IEP)
druggability_notes: Well-validated oncology target; multiple approved TKIs; gatekeeper mutation T315I known to confer resistance
why_chosen_for_pilot: Crystal structure publicly available with known binding mode
Multiple approved drugs provide ground-truth potency ranking
Known hERG liabilities (nilotinib, dasatinib) allow ADMET validation
Clinically relevant — leukemia is a key indication at academic medical centers
Allosteric site (asciminib) tests BioMate beyond ATP-site screening
